messages:
mira: quick heads-up — I'm swapping off early, leaving a short routing/tuning plan for the next 4h. Seeing noisy CPU spikes from the batch-gpu pool during our evening window. Proposing a temporary, scoped tweak: raise cpu_util alert from 75% -> 85% for the batch-gpu tag and route high-latency 5xx pages to #eng-oncall instead of paging infra. Also mute non-prod batch-job-failure alerts to cut churn. Will revert at 00:30 UTC.

tariq: sounds reasonable. can we scope the mute to job:batch AND env!=prod? i don't want to hide real prod regressions.

mira: yes — exactly that. yaml snippet i'll apply: 
```yaml
alert_rules:
  - name: BatchCPUHigh_temp
    match: "tag:batch AND pool:batch-gpu"
    threshold: 85
    duration: 5m
    note: "Temporary 4h bump to reduce noise during nightly workloads"

mute_rules:
  - name: MuteNonProdBatchFailures
    match: "job=batch AND env!=prod"
    until: "2026-03-18T00:30:00Z"

routes:
  - alert: HighLatency5xx
    from: eng-infra
    to: eng-oncall
    reason: "route to oncall during planned GPU noise window"
```

elaine: nice. please add a short handoff note in the oncall doc with the revert time so night shift sees it. also tagging ops-runbook if anything flares.

mira: adding now — link: https://redwood.internal/oncall/handovers/2026-03-17-batch-gpu-temp.json (handback + revert time).

sam: quick Q — do we expect any impact to serving latency for customer-facing routes if we bump threshold?

mira: minimal. this only prevents noisy pages for batch infra (background jobs). serving pools are unaffected. routing change only affects 5xx slowdowns that currently go to infra; we want oncall triage first to avoid cross-team escalations.

oncall-bot: Routing rule change queued: rc-20260317-7. ETA apply: 90s. Audit id: AU-9f2b.

elaine: :thumbsup: I'll cover the revert check at 00:20 UTC. if anything unexpected, ping me and i'll escalate.

tariq: if the routed pages start >3/min for 10m we should auto-fallback to infra. can we add that as a safety?

mira: good call. adding fallback policy: if eng-oncall gets >3 high-latency pages/min for 10m, route back to eng-infra and notify infra-sre. will include in the change.

oncall-bot: Change applied. rc-20260317-7 -> active.

mira: thanks all — leaving handoff note in the doc and marking myself as off. will monitor slack for the next 15m then sign out.

sam: noted. thanks for the clean plan. i'm on standby if anything spikes.

elaine: good handoff, enjoy the evening. :coffee:
